prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1329; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The injury does not fit the crash: the impact was very light, yet the claimed injury is severe.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The same service was billed twice for the same date, and the provider admitted the second charge was a repeat.
text:
Treatment summary

The patient presented after a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of neck and low back pain, and was diagnosed with cervical and lumbar strain. Over five visits, care followed a typical course of conservative management, including gentle range-of-motion exercises, manual therapy, and home stretching. Symptoms were reported as improving, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly before discharge from active care.

The reported severity of symptoms is greater than what the described impact would usually produce. Most of the findings are based on the patient's own account of pain. Cervical and lumbar imaging was unremarkable, and orthopedic and neurological examinations were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior problems in the same region. Billing records show one service entry duplicated for the same date; the provider confirmed the second entry was a repeat and has noted it for correction.

Recommendation: continue home exercise and return as needed for flare-ups.
